_help: Act 3, the riverboat (event riverboat_attack, before the attack): Charlie Whitfield on deck and his $500 wager (wager_offered; accept: wager_accepted). After this talk the boat is attacked and lost; then act3_stranded. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act3.py.

start.speaker: whitfield
start.line: Well, if it isn't the competition! Charlie Whitfield. Pull up a deckchair. Nobody's racing anybody on a boat this slow.

menu.speaker: whitfield
menu.line: So what do you say, friend?

choices.label: Ask what he's after
choices.line: What's an oilman want with a tomb?

choices.label: Hear his bet
choices.line: You look like a man with a proposition.

choices.label: Excuse yourself
choices.line: I'll leave you to your deckchair.

outfit.speaker: whitfield
outfit.line: Maggie there takes the pictures. Red Callahan keeps the bad men off. And half the guns on the docks, at a very fair price.

after.speaker: maggie
after.line: Charlie wants gold. I want the photograph that makes the front page. Between us we keep each other honest. Mostly.

wager.speaker: whitfield
wager.line: Five hundred dollars says my outfit reaches Akmentar before yours. A friendly wager, to make the trip interesting.

choices.label: Decline
choices.line: I don't bet on things I can't control.

accepted.speaker: whitfield
accepted.line: Ha! Now that's a sporting man. Maggie, write it down.

declined.speaker: whitfield
declined.line: Suit yourself. Offer stands, if you get your nerve back.

bye.speaker: whitfield
bye.line: Don't fall in. I hear the crocodiles are unionised.
